title: Intervention Geometry Shapes Apparent Positional-Encoding Robustness in Vision Transformers: Replication Package
description: Replication-only v2.0.0 release for the manuscript 'Intervention Geometry Shapes Apparent Positional-Encoding Robustness in Vision Transformers'. The archive contains frozen protocols, execution notebooks and source, masks and calibration/sample manifests, executed raw and aggregated evidence, sensitivity analyses, checkpoint provenance, plot data, expected outputs, and SHA-256 manifests. Manuscript, Supplement, bibliography, and Editorial Manager submission files are intentionally excluded. Mixed scholarly materials use file-specific rights; see LICENSE_SCOPE.md.
